q: The spectral measure of a unitary operator U on a Hilbert space is a projection-valued measure E on the unit circle S¹. For the Koopman operator U_T and f ∈ L²(μ), the spectral measure ν_f is the measure on S¹ satisfying:
opts: ∫ λ^n dν_f(λ) = ⟨U^n f, f⟩ = ∫ f(T^nx) f(x) dμ(x)
ν_f has atoms only at roots of unity
exp: Spectral measure: ⟨U^n f,f⟩ = ∫_{S¹} λ^n dν_f(λ). The spectral type of (X,T,μ) is classified by whether ν_f is purely atomic (pure point spectrum ↔ eigenfunctions dense ↔ Kronecker system), absolutely continuous, or singular continuous. These determine mixing properties.
